documents.title: Протокол между Правительством СССР и Правительством Турецкой Республики об определении линии морской границы между советскими и турецкими территориальными водами на Чёрном море
documents.institution: Министерство иностранных дел СССР / Сборник действующих договоров СССР
documents.publicationCitation: Сборник действующих договоров, соглашений и конвенций, заключённых СССР с иностранными государствами. Вып. 31. № 2296. С. 62; UNTS Vol. 990, I-14475.
documents.notes: Article 1 establishes a 290-degree azimuth from the terminal point of the land boundary to the common outer 12-nautical-mile territorial-sea limit. UNTS records entry into force on 27 March 1975 by exchange of instruments in Moscow.

documents.title: Protocol-Description of the Course of the Soviet-Turkish Sea Boundary Line between the Territorial Seas of the USSR and Turkey
documents.institution: Bilateral Soviet-Turkish boundary commission / reproduced in official ICJ case annexes
documents.publicationCitation: Protocol-Description, Tbilisi, 11 September 1980; identified in official ICJ case records and reproduced/analysed in Limits in the Seas No. 109.
documents.notes: The documentary record fixes the initial sea-boundary point at 41°31′18.39″ N, 41°32′55.06″ E; the demarcated endpoint is 41°35′43.41″ N, 41°16′40.88″ E. Limits in the Seas No. 109 is retained only as technical corroboration of the protocol transcription.
